visualCharacteristics.purpose: Image teaser cards with title, date and tag pills for projects and blog posts

contentPattern.structure: one row per card: image cell | body cell (linked title, date, optional tag list or an extra cell of comma-separated tags). Alternatively a single link to a listing path (e.g. /blog/) or a "source | /blog/" row (plus optional "limit | 4") lists pages under that path from /query-index.json, newest first; authored cards always render first

usage: Default: listing pages (/projects/, /blog/) with the first card featured full width and the rest in 2 columns. see-all-card: homepage teaser grid whose last row is a "See All" link rendered as a gradient arrow card.
reuseGuidance: Use for project/blog teasers. For the homepage grid add the see-all-card option and author the See All link as the last row.
